experiment_data.hypothesis: Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 在 ProofWriter-600 上 SICA vs SC：验证 regime boundary 跨域泛化。exp-033 (Mistral FOLIO-204) 显示 +4.90pp (p=0.013)，如果 PW-600 也显示正向 delta，则 regime-dependent capability trap 不是 FOLIO-specific artifact。

reproduce.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/symb_invariant_consensus && mkdir -p results/exp046_mistral_7b_pw600 && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0 python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server --model /root/autodl-tmp/models/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 --max-model-len 8192 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 --port 8002 --dtype auto --trust-remote-code --enforce-eager > /tmp/vllm_exp046.log 2>&1 & sleep 120 && python -u run_full_mvp.py --mode vllm --k 12 --temperature 0.7 --max-tokens 4096 --api-base http://localhost:8002/v1 --model auto --seed 42 --math-data data/empty.json --pw-data data/proofwriter_full.json --folio-data data/empty.json --output results/exp046_mistral_7b_pw600/exp046_results.json --save-intermediates 2>&1 | tee results/exp046_mistral_7b_pw600/exp046.log"
